goal: Read-only projection over current VCW session/effect/event/heartbeat authorities without inventing missing product truth.

verified_v3a3_source_binding.event_model: event_id AUTOINCREMENT + event_type + created_at + session_id? + project_id? + source + authoritative + payload
verified_v3a3_source_binding.production_bound_source_evidence: Phase7 deployed file digests and effect-kernel provenance digests matched byte-for-byte in V3-A3; current task does not re-read host Production because VCW grant expired.

source_identity.current_production_gap: schema v3 has no persistent event-store/source lineage id
source_identity.candidate_bootstrap: persist exactly once during deployment/bootstrap; projection reads never create or rotate it
source_identity.reason: event_id alone is not globally stable across database replacement/rebuild

snapshot.snapshot_revision_semantics: hash of authoritative/raw source content, excluding observed_at and derived age/remaining values

session_projection.elapsed_rule: execution_elapsed_seconds uses started_at/ended_at; created_at age remains a separate field
session_projection.unknown_state_rule: preserve raw state and classify state_class=UNKNOWN

heartbeat_projection.freshness_rule: STALE only when age_seconds > 30, matching current Dashboard display semantics
heartbeat_projection.non_rule: does not emit FAILED/SUSPECTED_STUCK task truth

effect_projection.unknown_state_rule: preserve raw state, state_known=false; do not coerce and do not fail the whole snapshot
effect_projection.required_backend_gap: project/task scoped list_public_effects; current gateway_effect_get requires pre-known effect identity/access material and is not a browse surface

event_projection.rule: events may invalidate/refetch; they never overwrite session/effect canonical truth

security.project_scope: all list/read operations must enforce exact project filter before returning rows

not_yet_verified: exact SQLiteEffectLedger list query against current deployed ledger schema
one-time source_instance_id bootstrap migration on VCW store

graft_scope: run existing VCW + Phase7 regressions in isolated candidate workspace
